newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Yields rise at latest Saudi treasury bill offer.
newsitem.headline: Yields rise at latest Saudi treasury bill offer.

text.p: Yields climbed at this week's Saudi Arabian Monetary Agency offering of two billion riyals worth of one-month to one-year treasury bills, bankers said.
The yield on 28-day bills climbed to 5.6877 percent from 5.6750 last week and the rate on 91-day bills rose to 5.8334 from 5.7936 percent.
The 182-day bills yielded 5.9945 percent from 5.9453 and the rate on 364-day bills rose to 6.2517 percent from 6.2342.
One-month interbank deposit rates were at 5-13/16, 11/16 and three-month funds were at 5-15/16, 13/16. Six-month deposits were 6-1/8, six percent and one-year rates were at 6-3/8, 1/4.
The bills were priced at 99.55957, 98.54688, 97.05859 and 94.05469 respectively.
